scope: Full FIPS 202 standard article: the six SHA-3 functions, KECCAK-p[1600,24], sponge parameters, suffixes and padding, bit/byte conversion, security table, HMAC block sizes, CAVP conformance, federal applicability, XOF related outputs, and the boundary with SP 800-185 derived functions. No completion claim for the sha3 algorithm entity, SP 800-185 functions, HMAC, protocols or any implementation.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 FIPS 202 标准文档：SHA-3 家族与 KECCAK-p 的参数、海绵结构、后缀与填充、位串转换、安全强度表、HMAC 块大小、CAVP 一致性、联邦适用范围、XOF 相关输出边界，以及 FIPS 202 与 SP 800-185 派生函数的分工。不把 sha3 算法实体、SP 800-185、HMAC、协议或具体实现并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the FIPS 202 standard document: the SHA-3 family and KECCAK-p parameters, sponge construction, suffixes and padding, bit/byte conversion, security table, HMAC block sizes, CAVP conformance, federal applicability, XOF related-output boundary, and the division of labor between FIPS 202 and SP 800-185 derived functions. It does not absorb the sha3 algorithm entity, SP 800-185, HMAC, protocols or any implementation.

title.en: FIPS 202: the SHA-3 and SHAKE standard

entry.relatedPolicy: These are distinct catalog entities. sha3 is the algorithm entity; fips180-4 is a different hash standard; HMAC is a keyed construction; cryptographic-hash is a generic term. FIPS 202 is the standard document that specifies the SHA-3 functions but does not replace those entities.
